overview: 2026年公司未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约事项，公告主要为季度业绩、股东大会及一般性事项。最新一季营收同比增长96.5%，但净利润转亏。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not disclose any business segment expansion, reduction, disposal, or new contract in its announcements; announcements mainly covered quarterly results, general meetings, and general matters. Latest quarter revenue grew 96.5% year-on-year, but net profit turned to a loss.
